description: Use Epi Info 7 StatCalc 'Diagnostic Test' calculator to evaluate a Rapid Fever Test based on the following study data: 1000 total patients, 200 Disease Positive, 800 Disease Negative. The test found 180 True Positives (among the 200 sick) and 40 False Positives (among the 800 healthy). Calculate the Sensitivity, Specificity, PPV, and NPV. Then, change the Prevalence to 2.0% (representing an airport screening scenario) and note the new PPV. Save the results to 'C:\Users\Docker\Documents\diagnostic_report.txt' in the format 'Key: Value%'.
